text: Hello grandma it is me your favorite grandson please do not tell mom and dad I am so embarrassed. I went on a trip to Chicago with some friends for the weekend and my car got towed and I got into a minor accident. The police are holding me until I pay for the damages to the city light pole. I need two thousand dollars right away to get released and get my car back. A legal representative named Arthur will call you to explain how to send the wire transfer. Can you help me out please grandma I am really scared and I really do not want my parents to find out about this. Oh sweetheart is that you Tyler your voice sounds so muffled. Yes I have a terrible cold from the holding cell. Please help me before five oclock today.

Hi grandpa it is Michael. I am calling you from the police department after getting into some trouble on my way home from college. The officer let me make one quick phone call and I knew I could trust you. I was a passenger in a friend car and they found something illegal in the glove box so they arrested both of us. My lawyer Mr. Vance is right next to me and he says I need money for bail bond paper processing fees immediately or I will have to spend the night in jail. Please do not call my mom she has enough stress with her job. Can you speak with Mr. Vance to handle the money. Michael you sound completely different are you sure you are okay. I am just really crying and upset grandpa please talk to my attorney right now.

Grandma please do not hang up I am in huge trouble and I do not know who else to turn to right now. My wallet and phone were stolen while I was at the train station in San Diego. A nice lady at a coffee shop is letting me use her phone to call you. I need money to buy a train ticket back home and pay for a room tonight. If I do not get fifteen hundred dollars by this afternoon I will be stranded on the street. Please go to the grocery store counter and buy gift cards then read the numbers to me. Wait a minute which grandchild is this is this Kevin. Yes it is Kevin grandma my throat is swollen from crying. Please hurry before this shop closes.

This is public defender Richard Hayes calling regarding your grandson Lucas. He was involved in a minor traffic incident earlier today and is currently being detained at the municipal precinct. Lucas asked me to reach out to you directly because he did not want to cause panic for his parents. To secure his release on administrative bail before the weekend judge signs off we need to process a cashier payment of three thousand dollars. Lucas is uninjured but very distraught. I can patch him through for a brief moment if you agree to cover the court collateral deposit today. Wait who did you say you were calling about Lucas. Yes maam Lucas your grandson. He needs you to secure his payment immediately.

Hello pops I am so glad you answered the phone. I am in a real emergency and I need your help right now. My voice sounds strange because I dropped my phone in the lake and I am using a borrowed phone with a bad speaker. I got pulled over earlier because my registration was expired and the officer found an unpaid parking citation from three years ago. Now they are holding me until someone posts bail. It is eighteen hundred dollars. Please do not mention this to my mother because she will lose her mind. A bail bondsman is going to come to your house to pick up the cash in an envelope. Can you do that for me pops. Hold on is this Justin. Yes pops it is Justin please hurry.

Hi grandma I am so sorry to call you so late in the day. I am down in Mexico for a wedding and my passport and credit cards were taken from my hotel room safe. The hotel manager says I have to pay for the remaining room balance and official consulate replacement fees before I am allowed to leave for the airport. It comes out to two thousand four hundred dollars. The embassy clerk told me to call family to send funds via bank transfer right away. Grandma I am terrified I am going to miss my flight back to the states. Can you please transfer the money to the embassy coordinator right now. Wait why did you not call your father first. He is out camping with no cell service grandma please help me.

Calling from the Medicare processing department regarding your updated plastic insurance card with the embedded chip. Oh good afternoon I was wondering why I had not received that yet. Yes maam we are sending out the new durable chip cards to replace the old paper ones to prevent fraud but I need to quickly confirm your current member ID number on your card to ensure the delivery address is correct. Wait a minute my old card is right here in my purse do you need the numbers on the front. Yes go ahead and read me those numbers so we can authorize the shipment today. Hold on my son told me Medicare never calls to ask for card numbers. Maam this is just to verify shipping details otherwise your benefits will be temporarily paused. No I am going to hang up and call the number on my card.

This is representative Arthur Pendelton calling from Medicare services regarding your annual medical benefit confirmation. Excuse me who did you say you were. I am calling from Medicare to make sure you do not lose your coverage for prescription drugs and routine checkups starting next month. Oh dear I pay my supplement plan every single month on time. I understand maam but our system shows a pending gap in your record that requires a small processing fee of forty-five dollars to keep your file active. Can I just pay that with my credit card right now. Yes absolutely I can take that card detail over the phone right now to clear up the flag. Wait let me find my glasses who did you say you work for again. This is Medicare verification maam please get your card ready. Hmm I think I better check with my daughter first goodbye.

Hello Mrs. Gable this is official Medicare outreach calling to inform you that you qualify for a free orthopedic back brace and knee support under your current plan. Oh really my knees have been hurting quite a bit lately when I work in the garden. That is wonderful news because Medicare fully covers these custom braces at zero cost to you but we do need to re-certify your Medicare ID card before we ship the package out. Well how do I do that. You just need to read me the letter and number combination from your red white and blue card so I can verify your account in the national database. Is there any paperwork my doctor has to sign first. No maam no doctor visit is required we handle everything directly. Oh that sounds a bit strange let me ask my doctor first.

Hi there I am calling on behalf of the Medicare administrative center regarding an urgent system upgrade for all beneficiaries in your zip code. Oh hello what kind of upgrade. We are updating our database to prevent identity theft so we need to verify your social security number and full date of birth today. Goodness I thought Medicare moved away from using social security numbers a few years ago. That is correct sir but we still need to match your old file to the new system to make sure your doctors get paid properly. Well I do not feel comfortable giving out my social security number over an incoming phone call. Sir if we cannot verify your file your coverage could be temporarily suspended by midnight. Well then I will just visit the local office in town tomorrow thank you.

Urgent message regarding a refund check owed to you from Medicare for overpaid billing last year. Oh I was not expecting any money back. Yes sir our audit found an overpayment of two hundred and fifteen dollars that belongs to you but our direct deposit failed because we have outdated bank account information on file. Well usually Medicare sends me a check in the mail. We can send a paper check sir but it takes eight weeks whereas direct deposit takes two days if you verify your routing and checking account details with me now. Two hundred dollars sounds nice but I really do not like giving out my bank numbers on the phone. It is completely secure sir I am an authorized representative. No thank you just mail me the paper check goodbye.

This is Sarah Jenkins from the Medicare senior wellness department reaching out for your annual preventative care review. Oh hello Sarah I just had my annual checkup with Dr. Henderson last month. That is great to hear Mr. Vance but our records show that your doctor did not submit the mandatory health risk assessment form to Medicare yet. Oh I see do I need to call his office. You can do that or I can update the file right now if you can verify your Medicare claim number and your mother maiden name. Well I have my card right here but why do you need my mother maiden name for medical records. It is a security question to prove your identity on speaker system. That sounds suspicious to me young lady I will call Dr. Henderson directly.

Hello is this Mary Wilson yes it is Mary this is Officer Agent Thomas calling from the Social Security Administration regarding an urgent matter with your Social Security number our system flagged suspicious fraudulent activity registered under your number in another state and a federal warrant has been issued to suspend your benefit payments immediately oh my goodness what does that mean well ma'am to clear your name and lift the suspension we need to verify your identity right now on this call by having you confirm your full Social Security number and date of birth wait a minute I thought the government mailed letters about these things ma'am this is a formal legal investigation if you hang up local law enforcement will be dispatched to your home address to process an arrest immediately I don't know this sounds very scary let me call my daughter first

Hi good afternoon I am calling from the Social Security Administration fraud department to reach Arthur Vance yes speaking well Mr Vance we are notifying you that your Social Security number has been compromised in connection with multiple fraudulent bank accounts and an abandoned vehicle found near the border oh dear Lord how could that happen I have never been anywhere near the border our department is preparing to freeze all assets associated with your Social Security number within the hour unless we secure your file right now hold on why would my bank accounts be involved I need to confirm your full Social Security number and your current address so I can prevent the freeze and protect your funds wait no I am not giving out that information over the phone I will walk into the local Social Security office myself goodbye

Social Security Administration notice line reaching out to Harold Davis regarding an emergency suspension order on your Social Security number which went into effect earlier today wait what suspension I get my benefit check every month why would it be suspended sir our enforcement unit has detected unauthorized credit applications using your identifier across three states and federal law requires us to lock the number until verification is complete mercy me what do I have to do to fix it you must immediately state your complete Social Security number to the automated verification system so we can clear your account before legal action proceeds you know I read an article last week that said Social Security never calls people out of the blue demanding information like this sir if you refuse to cooperate your monthly payments will be permanently terminated I think I will take my chances and hang up now

This is Inspector Raymond from the Social Security Administration identity protection task force reaching Mrs Evelyn Bennett yes this is Evelyn well Mrs Bennett I am calling to inform you that your Social Security number has been linked to a serious fraud case involving identity theft oh my goodness I haven't worked in decades how could that be somebody has stolen your credentials ma'am and we need to issue you a brand new Social Security number today to secure your monthly checks okay what do I need to do first I must verify your current Social Security number and mother's maiden name to transfer your benefits to the new file wait a minute can you send me something in writing first no ma'am this must be processed immediately over the line or your accounts will be frozen oh I do not like the sound of this let me talk to my son

Hello am I speaking with Frank Miller yes you are Frank this is Agent Kelly calling from Social Security headquarters in Baltimore regarding a cost of living benefit adjustment linked to your Social Security number oh wonderful is my benefit check going up yes sir but our system shows your account profile has an unverified Social Security number flag that is blocking the increase payout amount is that so what do I need to clear that up I just need to cross check your Social Security number and date of birth right now so we can authorize the additional two hundred dollars per month to your account well can't you just look up my file on your computer sir for privacy compliance you must state the number aloud to me so I can update the federal system oh well I don't have my card on me right now let me go find my glasses and look for it in the drawer hold on a second

Hi is this Dorothy Palmer yes speaking Dorothy this is Officer Martin from the Social Security Administration investigation branch calling about an urgent security breach involving your Social Security number oh my goodness what kind of breach we detected suspicious activity where someone tried to open multiple credit lines using your Social Security number in another city so we have temporarily suspended your number to safeguard your assets lord have mercy what am I supposed to do now to resolve this and protect your monthly benefit payment I will guide you through our secure verification process right now please read off your full Social Security number to verify ownership wait a minute the last time someone called me like this it turned out to be a scammer trying to trick me ma'am if you do not verify your Social Security number right now your benefits remain suspended indefinitely I am going to hang up and call the real office directly goodbye

Internal Revenue Service criminal investigation division calling regarding an unpaid tax balance under your name. We have sent multiple written notices to your home address without any response. Who is this I am retired and I do not think I owe anything. Ma'am according to our official audit you owe four thousand two hundred dollars in back taxes from two tax years ago. If this amount is not settled immediately today an arrest warrant will be issued by local law enforcement. Oh my goodness I always pay my taxes on time my accountant handles everything. Well your accountant made a severe error and if you do not stay on the line to process a wire transfer right now police will arrive at your home within thirty minutes. Wait let me find my paperwork first. Do not hang up or you will be arrested.

This is Officer Thomas Vance from the Internal Revenue Service reaching out to Arthur Pendelton regarding tax fraud charges that have been filed against you in federal court. Excuse me who did you say you were calling for. I am calling for Arthur Pendelton regarding a missing tax file that resulted in a audit penalty of twelve hundred dollars. Well I am Arthur but I never got any letters from the government about this. Sir the notifications were returned as undeliverable which is why your file was sent to our legal enforcement office. To stop further legal action you must purchase electronic store vouchers today and read the serial numbers to me over the phone. Vouchers I do not understand why the IRS would want vouchers. It is the required legal procedure for delinquent accounts sir. Let me call my daughter first. If you disconnect we will initiate legal proceedings.

Hello Mrs. Gable this is Agent Miller with the Department of the Treasury tax fraud enforcement unit. I am calling to inform you that your tax filing from last year contains miscalculations that must be resolved today. Oh dear I had no idea I am ninety years old and my nephew usually helps me with all of that paperwork. I understand Mrs. Gable but our records show a remaining balance of two thousand three hundred dollars that is long overdue. You need to make an immediate card payment over this secure line right now or we will freeze your bank accounts within the hour. Goodness can I just mail a check to your office like I usually do. No ma'am checks take too long and your file will be marked for immediate asset seizure if you do not pay now. Well this sounds very suspicious to me I am hanging up now.

Hi there I am calling from the Internal Revenue Service regional administrative bureau to speak with Harold. Yes this is Harold what is this about. Harold we are notifying you that an overpayment refund of eight hundred dollars was mistakenly deposited into your checking account and must be returned to the government immediately. Really I did not notice any extra money in my account. Yes it was an automated payroll tax credit error on our end. If you do not verify your banking credentials right now so we can reverse the transaction your social security benefits will be suspended starting tomorrow morning. That sounds terrible but I am not comfortable giving out my bank information over the phone. Sir this is standard federal protocol to resolve government overpayments. Well I think I will walk down to the local tax office to sort this out in person goodbye.

Urgent notification from the tax settlement bureau for Raymond Douglas regarding overdue tax penalties. Please state your full name to confirm you are on the line. What is going on who is calling me. Sir you owe three thousand five hundred dollars in back taxes and accrued interest from tax misreporting. If this balance is not paid before five o'clock today federal marshals will be dispatched to your residence. Federal marshals over a tax issue this must be a mistake I paid everything I owed back in April. Sir our automated system shows nonpayment and failure to respond to federal summons. You can settle this right now using a preloaded debit card to avoid arrest. I do not have any preloaded card and I am going to call my accountant right away to verify this. If you hang up your case will be sent to local law enforcement immediately.

This is Senior Inspector David Clark from the Internal Revenue Service hotline calling regarding case file ninety four B. Is this Clara Jennings. Yes speaking who is this again. Mrs. Jennings our audit division discovered an unpaid tax debt of fifteen hundred dollars on your last joint tax filing. Oh my goodness my husband passed away last year he always took care of the finances. I am sorry for your loss ma'am but the debt remains attached to your estate. If you clear the balance today using a wire transfer service we can waive all late fees and penalty charges. That sounds like a lot of money to send over the phone I need to check my bank balance first. We can wait on the line while you check but you must not disconnect this call or the offer will expire and legal charges will be filed. Let me call my son first he helps me with these things.

Hello Mrs. Gable this is David from customer tech center following up on the network security alerts generated by your desktop computer. We received automated flags showing your system was infected with malicious spyware that is transmitting your private data. I need you to sit down at your computer right now so we can walk through clearing these threats before your network gets shut down completely. Well I was just making tea what kind of spyware is it. It is very severe ma'am it compromises everything on your hard drive. If you open your internet browser I can direct you to our security portal to grant me remote access. Oh dear I am not very good with computers let me call my nephew first. No ma'am there is no time for that your network connection will be terminated within minutes if we do not fix it now.

Hi there I am reaching out from device security support regarding your tablet. Our server detected multiple unauthorized sign-in attempts from another state on your account this morning. We need to verify your identity and refund the fraudulent charge for an extended warranty app that was purchased. Wait a minute I did not buy any warranty app on my tablet. Exactly that is why we are calling to stop the transfer and return your funds. To process the refund I just need you to press the power button and read me the code that pops up on your screen. I do not see any code popping up it is just showing my picture background. You have to tap the notification bar at the top ma'am do you see the bright red icon there. No I do not see anything red I think I am going to hang up and take this to the store.

Urgently calling to inform you that your automatic computer protection subscription of two hundred and ninety nine dollars has expired and your device is now vulnerable to high level threats. We noticed unauthorized remote access from an overseas location currently downloading your personal files. Who is this I did not authorize any renewal or payment. Ma'am please do not panic I am the senior technician assigned to help you cancel this charge and secure your operating system. You need to turn on your laptop immediately and type in a web address I am going to give you. I do not even have my laptop plugged in and this sounds like a total scam to me. Ma'am if you do not act right now your bank account linked to the device will be drained. I am hanging up now do not call me back.

This is Kevin from your internet service provider calling to address the severe network slowdown reported in your neighborhood. Our technicians ran a diagnostic scan on your router and found that your desktop is broadcasting harmful spam packets. Are you sitting near your machine right now. Oh goodness my internet has been a little slow today is that why. Yes ma'am malware is taking up all your bandwidth. To clear the system corruption I need you to open a program called command prompt so I can read you the decryption commands. How do I find that program I only know how to check my email. Do not worry I will guide you step by step just press the key with the small flag on your keyboard and the letter r at the same time. Okay wait let me put my glasses on first.

Hello Arthur this is Ray from global software support following up on your recent service bill. It looks like our billing department accidentally charged your card four hundred and ninety dollars instead of forty nine dollars for your annual subscription renewal. We are trying to issue an immediate credit back to your account today. Oh my goodness four hundred and ninety dollars that is a lot of money. Yes sir we sincerely apologize for the error. To process the direct deposit refund I need you to log into your computer so we can establish a secure screen sharing session and fill out the cancellation form together. Can you not just credit my credit card back the way you charged it. Unfortunately our direct refund system requires confirmation through the online customer portal on your screen sir.

Hi Mr. Henderson this is Sarah from mobile device support calling about your smartphone. Our security department flagged your line because your handset is currently infected with a trojan virus that is sending thousands of text messages to foreign countries. If we do not clean the phone right away your wireless service will be suspended and you will be billed for international roaming rates. Oh dear lord I barely use my phone except to call my daughter how could that happen. These viruses hide in simple games or website ads sir. I can remove it remotely right now but I need you to open your mobile app store and download a temporary maintenance tool called quick support. Is that going to cost me anything I am on a very tight fixed income. No sir the tool is completely free but we must do it before your line is disconnected.

Urgent notification regarding your computer security system which expired yesterday. Oh dear I did not know I had a system expiring. Yes maam your protection ended and to renew it today for two hundred dollars we require payment using store shopping gift cards like Target or Walmart. Wait why would computer support need store gift cards instead of my regular credit card? Because our electronic merchant portal is currently undergoing server maintenance so retail gift cards are the only secure method accepted today. If you go to the store now and read the numbers on the back we can clear the virus immediately. I do not think I feel comfortable doing that let me talk to my son first. Maam if you hang up your computer will be locked permanently. I am hanging up anyway goodbye.

This is officer Davis calling from the county utility enforcement division concerning your unpaid electric balance of four hundred dollars. Excuse me I paid my power bill last week. According to our system that payment failed to process and your service is scheduled for disconnect within the hour unless settled immediately. Well how can I settle it right now if my regular card did not go through? We are taking emergency payments through digital gift cards specifically Google Play or Apple cards which you can purchase at the nearby pharmacy. Gift cards for an electric bill that sounds very unusual. It is our emergency backup collection protocol maam if you do not buy four hundred dollars in cards and call back with the scratch off codes your lights will go out today. Oh my goodness let me look for my paper receipt first I do not believe this.

Hello grandma it is Tommy I am in big trouble please do not tell mom and dad. Tommy is that you what happened where are you? I got into a fender bender in town and the police took me to jail and I need bail money right away. Oh no Tommy are you alright how much is the bail? It is eight hundred dollars grandma but the public defender said because of the weekend the court system can only accept bail payments formatted as store gift cards like Vanilla Visa or Target cards. Store gift cards for court bail Tommy that does not sound right at all. Yes grandma the lawyer said it is the fastest way to post bond before monday. Can you go to the store and get eight hundred dollars worth of cards? I am going to call your mother right now Tommy this sounds like a scam. Grandma please do not hang up.

Hi Mr. Henderson I am calling from the national sweepstakes committee with fantastic news about your grand prize entry. Oh really did I actually win something? Yes sir you have won five hundred thousand dollars and a new car but before we can deliver the oversized check to your home we need to register the state tax processing fee of three hundred dollars. Okay well can you just deduct that fee from the prize money? Unfortunately federal regulation prevents us from touching the prize total prior to delivery so you must cover the fee upfront using eBay or retail gift cards. Why on earth would federal taxes be paid with retail gift cards? It is due to our official partnership with major retailers for instant payment verification sir if you purchase the cards now our delivery truck can be at your house by five oclock. No I am not buying gift cards for a prize goodbye.

Attention required on your social security file due to suspicious activity detected in another state. Oh my gracious who is calling? Representative Miller from the federal security office your benefits are being frozen until we resolve a legal issue associated with your name. Heavens what legal issue I have done nothing wrong. To protect your funds you must liquidate your current account balance of five hundred dollars and convert it into safety cards from a nearby retail center like Target. Safety cards what are safety cards? They are prepaid store gift cards that protect your money from government seizure while we investigate. Once you purchase them you read the numbers on the back to me over the phone. That sounds completely fake why would government safety cards be bought at Target? Maam if you refuse to cooperate a warrant will be issued for your arrest immediately. I am going straight to the local social security office in person goodbye.

This is Marcus calling from the fraud protection department at First National Bank. Am I speaking with Arthur Pendelton? Yes speaking what is this about? We detected two suspicious charges on your checking account from an online store in Florida just a few minutes ago. One was for four hundred dollars and the other for six hundred dollars. Oh my goodness I did not make those purchases. We assumed so sir that is why we flagged them immediately. To stop these pending transfers and secure your account I just need to verify a quick security code that was sent to your phone. Can you read that back to me? Wait a second my grandson told me never to give out codes over the phone. Sir if we do not cancel this right now the funds will leave your account permanently. Well I am going to call the bank branch directly goodbye.

Hello Mrs. Gable this is Sarah from Community Trust Credit Union fraud investigation desk. We are calling to confirm a wire transfer of twelve hundred dollars that was just initiated from your savings account to an offshore entity. What twelve hundred dollars I never authorized anything like that. That is what we suspected ma'am which is why the system put a temporary hold on the transaction. To reverse the transfer and freeze your compromised online portal I need you to confirm your debit card pin and full social security number so I can verify your identity. Goodness I am so shaken up but wait why do you need my pin number? It is standard procedure to unlock the emergency fraud resolution protocol ma'am time is running out. Let me check with my daughter first she handles my banking online. Ma'am if you hang up the hold expires. I am hanging up anyway.

Hi Mr. Henderson this is David from Horizon Bank security center calling about an urgent alert on your debit card. We noticed several unauthorized charges totaling eight hundred dollars made at a retail store across state lines this morning. Oh dear I have my card right here in my wallet how could that happen? Fraudsters often clone card data sir but don't worry we can reverse the charges immediately. I just need to verify that I am talking to the account owner by having you confirm the full sixteen digit card number and the security code on the back. Well can't you see my account details on your screen already? Due to strict privacy laws those details are masked on my end sir so I need you to read them to me to unlock the security override. That sounds a bit suspicious to me I think I will walk down to the local branch instead.

Calling from the fraud risk team at Apex Financial Group regarding an urgent security breach on your primary checking account. Is this Eleanor Vance? Yes it is who did you say you were? My name is Jason from account security ma'am. Someone is currently attempting to withdraw two thousand dollars from an ATM in Chicago using your credentials. Did you authorize this transaction? Absolutely not I am sitting right here in my kitchen in Ohio. We need to block the transfer right now before the automated batch processes in three minutes. To stop it I need you to read me the temporary passcode that just popped up on your cell phone screen. Passcode what screen? Check your text messages ma'am read those numbers to me immediately. Oh wait my son told me the bank never asks for passcodes over the phone. Ma'am if you do not cooperate the money will be gone forever. I am hanging up now.

This is Rachel from Valley Federal Credit Union calling for Harold Stevens regarding suspicious debit activity flagged by our automated monitoring system. Mr. Stevens we see a pending charge for nine hundred dollars to an international electronics merchant. Was this purchase made by you or anyone in your household? No definitely not I haven't bought any electronics. Thank you for clarifying sir. To protect your account we are closing this debit card and issuing a replacement right now. However to issue the new card and transfer your remaining funds to a secure temporary account I need you to verify your full card number and the three digit CVV code on the back. Hold on a minute why would you need my old card details if you are cancelling it? Sir it is required to authenticate the card destruction request in our system. I don't feel comfortable giving that out I will call the customer service number on my statement.

Hello is this Arthur Miller yes speaking great news Arthur you have been selected as the grand prize winner in our national senior fortune sweepstakes you won fifty thousand dollars cash and a brand new luxury vehicle oh my goodness really I do not remember entering any sweepstakes well your entry was submitted automatically through your supermarket rewards program now to process the release of your winnings and cover the state delivery taxes we just need a small processing fee of two hundred dollars paid today using a retail cash card wait a minute why do I have to pay money to get a prize that sounds odd sir it is standard procedure for federal tax compliance if you want the check delivered tomorrow morning I need you to stay on the line while we set that up well I need to talk to my daughter first before doing anything like that sir the offer expires once we hang up.

Hi Mrs. Evelyn Reynolds this is Marcus from the North American Readers Guild calling to congratulate you on winning our annual lifetime reward draw of two million dollars oh Lord have mercy are you serious yes maam your check is sitting right here on my desk ready to be dispatched by courier service all we need to do right now is confirm your identity and set up the direct deposit transfer into your checking account so you do not have to pay any high wire fees well can you just send a check in the mail to my house I do not give out my banking information over the phone maam because of the large amount we must complete the security verification online today or the funds will revert to the runner up do you have your checkbook handy no I am hanging up now this sounds like a trick.

Congratulations Mr. Samuel Parker your name was drawn for the chief executive prize package valued at seven hundred and fifty thousand dollars I am calling from the payout center to get your mailing address verified wait who is this I did not sign up for anything sir your name was drawn from a nationwide database of retired homeowners you are guaranteed the cash payout today but before the legal team can sign off on sending the certified cashier check you must transfer five hundred dollars for the customs duty fee can you make it to a local department store today to buy a prepaid card no I certainly will not do that if I won a prize you should deduct any fees from the total amount sir regulations forbid us from touching the prize principal you need to make the payment now to claim it goodbye.

This is Brandon from the Global Rewards Center getting back to you regarding the grand prize cruise ticket and five thousand dollars spending cash you won at the county fair exhibit earlier this year oh my goodness I remember filling out a slip at the fair back in August I cannot believe I actually won yes maam you are the lucky winner out of thousands of entries we just need to finalize your reservation details right now and secure your spot on the ship there is just a small resort fee of one hundred and twenty dollars to lock in your travel dates do you have a major credit card nearby that we can use for that quick transaction wait a minute I thought the fair flyer said everything was completely free maam the cruise is free the fee is just for the port tax.

Hello Mrs. Clara Higgins I am calling to inform you that you have been chosen for our mystery shopper reward program which includes a five hundred dollar gift card to your favorite grocery store plus a bonus cash incentive oh well that sounds lovely what do I need to do to get it it is very simple we just need to verify a few personal details to make sure we are sending the voucher to the right person can you confirm your full name social security number and date of birth for the file wait why on earth would you need my social security number for a grocery store gift card that does not sound right at all maam it is required for tax reporting purposes for any rewards over one hundred dollars if you refuse we will have to pass this reward to the next person on the list well you go right ahead and pass it along then I am hanging up.

Hi sweetheart it is Arthur calling you from the platform in the North Sea. Oh Arthur I am so glad to hear your voice how are you doing out there. Well darling things are a bit stressful right now a crucial turbine broke down and the company requires me to purchase the replacement part out of pocket before they reimburse me. Oh no that sounds terrible how much is it. It is around four thousand dollars and my overseas account is currently frozen due to security updates. I was wondering if you could wire the money to the parts vendor today so I can finish this contract and come home to you finally. Arthur that is a lot of money I need to think about this. Please my love I need your help right now or I cannot leave.

Darling can you hear me properly I am at the airport gate in Istanbul right now and they are holding my luggage. Julian is that you why are you calling from a different number. Yes my love my battery died so I borrowed a phone from a worker here. Listen they say there is an unexpected airport clearance tax of fifteen hundred dollars that must be paid in cash or gift cards immediately before they let me board the flight to come see you. Julian we have been talking for three months but every time we plan to meet some emergency happens where you need money. Sweetheart I promise you as soon as I land tomorrow I will pay you back every single cent please just go to the store and get those cards so I do not miss this plane. I do not think I can do that Julian something feels wrong.

This is Richard calling you my dear I hope you are having a peaceful evening. Oh Richard it is so good to hear your voice how is your medical project coming along over in Ghana. It was going very well until an hour ago when my daughter back in boarding school had a sudden medical emergency and requires urgent surgery. Oh my goodness Richard that is awful is she going to be okay. She will be fine if the hospital performs the procedure immediately but they are refusing to admit her until the fee of three thousand dollars is deposited. My financial manager cannot transfer funds until Monday morning because of the time difference. Can you please wire the payment for her medical treatment right away my love I will transfer double that back to you on Monday. Yes of course Richard let me get my purse.

Hello beautiful I miss you so much and I cannot wait until our wedding next month. Hello David it is nice to hear from you but wait wedding next month we have only been messaging online for five weeks and we have never even met in person yet. Calling from First Security Bank fraud prevention department for Arthur Pendelton. Oh yes this is Arthur speaking. Hello is this Robert Vance? Yes this is Robert who is calling? Mr. Vance I am calling from Summit Federal Credit Union fraud monitoring department. Hi may I speak with Eleanor Brooks? Yes this is Eleanor. Ms. Brooks this is the security team at Oak Valley Bank. Hello am I speaking with Frank Reynolds? Yes this is Frank. Mr. Reynolds this is the security center at Valley First Bank. Grandma can you hear me okay my phone battery is low. Oh Tyler is that you yes it is grandma listen I am at the gas station near campus and I realized I left my wallet in my dorm room.
